purpose: deliberately calibrated acceptance scenario after observing previous experimental results, not blind validation

design.purpose: calibrated demonstration and acceptance scenario under TZ 3.2; not blind or representative validation
design.design_context: distribution explicitly chosen after earlier benchmark results to exercise the declared aggregate acceptance metrics
design.cohort: 147 professionals sharing Python and Git, 3 Android specialists, 50 novices
design.grouping: five target professional directions, forty applicants per direction; novices are applicants to that direction
design.rare_query: one mobile vacancy with only three suitable people; reduces Precision@K and increases macro Recall; per-query results must be disclosed
design.noise: one ability omitted for index%4==0; fixed surface variants; half of skills inside work descriptions
design.selection: all 200 generated candidates, all 10 vacancies and all 2000 pairs; no post-run row removal
design.reference: authored synthetic abilities, no independent expert suitability judgement
design.freeze: files, labels, fixed seed and unmodified production algorithm frozen before measurement
design.layout: authored HH-style structure, not exported by hh.ru; exact template conformity pending
design.limitations: negation/adversarial cases evaluated separately in pmi_it_challenging_2026-11-18; aggregate success does not establish general real-world quality
